title: LangGraph AI Data Scientist: CSV Analysis to Report
summary: Riccardo Pirruccio builds a LangGraph agent team that analyzes CSV data and writes a report.
learn: A data analyst agent takes files and instructions, pulls out insights and generates charts.
A writer agent builds the report: title, table of contents, introduction, sections, conclusion and sources.
A runnable lambda runs every file and instruction combination in parallel.
A publisher agent outputs markdown, PDF or Word.
A Pydantic state object validates each agent output and carries it to the next node.
